context: A retired mentor and a uni student talk about choosing a path
purpose: Teach: 幼児/こころ/叫び/貧しい/筈/云々/前者/師匠

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、進路で迷っています。研究と就職、前者に進むべきか、ずっと考えていて。
lines.en: Sensei, I'm torn about my path. I keep wondering whether to go with the former, research.
lines.style: Hesitant student opening up, polite and slightly anxious tone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ふむ、若い頃の迷いか。わしも昔、師匠にまったく同じことを相談したよ。
lines.en: Hmm, the doubts of youth. I once consulted my master about the exact same thing long ago.
lines.style: Warm reflective elder, gentle and reminiscent in delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正直、こころのどこかで小さな叫びが聞こえるんです。本当の道は別にある筈だって。
lines.en: Honestly, somewhere in my heart I can hear a small cry, saying my real path must lie elsewhere.
lines.style: Emotionally raw confession, voice trembling with bottled frustration

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: その声を無視してはいかん。まだ幼児だった頃、夢中になっていたことは何だ?
lines.en: You mustn't ignore that voice. Back when you were still a small child, what were you absorbed in?
lines.style: Probing but kind, slow steady cadence like an old teacher

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 絵を描くことです。でも、絵描きは貧しい暮らしをするって、親が云々言ってきて…。
lines.en: Drawing pictures. But my parents keep going on about how painters live poor lives and such.
lines.style: Sheepish admission, voice trailing off with embarrassment

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 親の心配ももっともだ。だが安定云々より、自分が本気で燃えられる道を選ぶがよい。
lines.en: Your parents' worries are reasonable. But rather than stability and such, choose a path that truly ignites you.
lines.style: Decisive elder wisdom, firm yet compassionate delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いい先生に出会えたら、絵の道でも何とかやっていけるでしょうか。
lines.en: If I could meet a good teacher, could I somehow make it work on the art path too?
lines.style: Tentative hopeful question, voice lifting slightly with possibility

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 自分から動けば、よき師匠との縁は必ず来る。こころが決まったなら、わしも応援するぞ。
lines.en: If you move yourself, the bond with a good master will surely come. Once your heart is set, I'll cheer you on too.
lines.style: Reassuring grandfatherly closure, warm and quietly confident
